description: This file defines the ListViewSmartyEmails class, which extends ListViewSmarty to handle the display and setup of email list views within the SuiteCRM environment. It includes constructor initialization and a setup method for configuring list view parameters specific to emails.

classes.name: ListViewSmartyEmails
classes.description: A subclass of ListViewSmarty specialized for handling email list views within SuiteCRM, providing customized setup logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ListViewSmartyEmails object by calling the parent constructor and creating instances of Sugar_Smarty and ListViewDataEmails, also initializes searchColumns array.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the list view display, offsets, filters, exports, mass updates, and other parameters based on passed arguments, preparing the view for rendering email data.
